subject: Hosted API sandbox walkthrough for HopperAI — slot options & prework
messages:
From: Samir Patel <sam@hopperai.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick hosted API walkthrough?

Hi Lauren,

I signed up for the Redwood hosted API sandbox this morning (we're really liking the docs) and would love a short live walkthrough — specifically a 30-minute session to:
- Confirm sandbox access and example requests for generating embeddings
- Talk performance/latency tradeoffs for our use case (short docs + real-time search)
- See any quick config tips to reduce token cost

We're a small infra team at HopperAI and can do a demo this week or early next week. Our timezone is PST. Availability I can do:
- Tue Aug 4: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Aug 5: 09:00–12:00

A bit about us: we're building a retrieval layer over short customer documents (~1–3 paragraphs); expected traffic for a pilot ~200 requests/minute with 128-token avg responses. Happy to share more details in the call.

Attached a one-pager on our infra and goals.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of ML Engineering
HopperAI
Attachments: hopperai-infra-notes.docx
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <sam@hopperai.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API walkthrough?

Hi Samir — welcome and thanks for signing up!

I can take a first pass to get you into a sandbox and then loop Diego (solutions engineer) into a short technical walkthrough focused on latency and cost options. Proposed 30-minute slots (PST):
- Tue Aug 4 — 10:30–11:00 or 14:30–15:00
- Wed Aug 5 — 09:30–10:00

If one of these works reply with the preferred slot and I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Agenda (30m)
- 5m:-intros + goals
- 10m: quick live sandbox run (requests, embeddings, sample latency)
- 10m: tuning advice (batching, quantization recommendations, model choice)
- 5m: next steps (Dedicated vs hosted pilot options, provisioning)

Diego — adding you for the technical bit. Can you also attach sandbox access instructions so Samir can pre-check? Monica, cc'd, will provision extra sandbox IPs if they need a larger concurrency quota for testing.

Link to pick a time or decline: https://cal.redwood.ai/lauren-bishop/30min

Thanks — talk soon,
Lauren Bishop
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <sam@hopperai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API walkthrough? — sandbox prework

Hi Samir — nice to meet you over email.

Attaching a short PDF with step-by-step sandbox access + a recommended preflight curl command so we can see a baseline latency. If you can run that before the session it will help us use the 30 minutes efficiently.

Couple of quick asks to tailor the walkthrough:
- approx corpus size (documents) and avg doc length (tokens)
- expected qps during pilot and target SLO for response time (p95)

If you're planning to hit ~200 rps we may suggest a different batching config and a lower-latency model variant for ranking. Monica, can you confirm we have the sandbox quota bumped to allow up to 250 concurrent requests for HopperAI?

Attachments: sandbox-access-instructions.pdf

— Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <sam@hopperai.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API walkthrough? — slot confirmed (reschedule note)

Hi Lauren/Diego — thanks for the quick turnaround. I'll take Tue Aug 4 14:30–15:00 PST (that works best).

I ran the preflight curl Diego sent; baseline p95 for our sample request is ~320ms from our office in SF. Corpus is ~18k short docs; avg length ~60–120 tokens. We'll aim for 200 qps during the pilot.

Small change — one of our infra leads will be joining and prefers 15:00–15:30 if that's possible; can we nudge the invite 30 min later? If Diego/Monica are available that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Samir
— Samir Patel
Head of ML Engineering, HopperAI
(Later: Lauren updates calendar invite to 15:00–15:30 PST and sends confirmation; thread ends with short calendar acceptances from internal participants.)
